name: Amabishi Merja
source:
The daughter of Evsej Amabishi, CEO of the massive Amabishi Corporation. She has mixed Japanese and Russian heritage.

[spoiler]Merja has the psychic power of psychometry, able to determine an object's history though physical contact.[/spoiler]
